questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Didn't really use any.
I was part of the buddy system (which was nice) and a reading Group which was great
I got a museum card, which was great (but not a part of the Uni).

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Getting a Museum card! so worth it

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Getting a Museum card and going to a different city (not just amsterdam) a see their big and small museums for free.
In the spring go to mardi gras, it was fun, though the cummute was long.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: For a Dane very easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Ask after class if any wants to eat lunch or drink a cup of coffee. They will properbly not answer the first time, but 3rd or 4th the migth want to join.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: that the cafes close at 5pm

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: the Biking and many museums

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Do so many practical things beforehand as you can
Get a bike and a museums card quickly 
Write and aske the professors when in doubt about the courses and exams
